mapper.select: select * from qa_session where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and course_id=#{courseId} and user_id=#{userId} and id=#{sessionId} and del_flag='0' and status='active'
mapper.update: update qa_message set del_flag='2',update_time=now() where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and del_flag='0'
update qa_session set title=#{title},update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and del_flag='0'
update qa_session set update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from qa_message where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and del_flag='0' order by id
mapper.update: update qa_message set content=#{content},status=#{status},reject_reason=#{rejectReason}, retrieval_log_ref=#{retrievalLogRef},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and role='assistant' and status='pending' and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from qa_message_citation where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and message_id=#{messageId} and del_flag='0' order by rank_no,id

select c.* from qa_message_citation c join qa_message m on m.id=c.message_id and m.tenant_id=c.tenant_id and m.del_flag='0' where c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and c.message_id=#{messageId} and c.id=#{citationId} and c.del_flag='0'

select count(*)::bigint as question_count, count(*) filter (where o.answer_status = 'insufficient_evidence')::bigint as insufficient_evidence_count, count(*) filter (where o.no_valid_citation is true)::bigint as no_valid_citation_count, count(*) filter (where coalesce(o.weak_citation_count, 0) > 0)::bigint as weak_citation_count, count(*) filter (where o.retrieval_channel in ('keyword_only', 'vector_only', 'empty'))::bigint as fallback_count, case when count(*) = 0 then 0 else round((count(*) filter (where o.answer_status = 'insufficient_evidence'))::numeric / count(*), 4) end as insufficient_evidence_rate, case when count(*) = 0 then 0 else round((count(*) filter (where o.no_valid_citation is true))::numeric / count(*), 4) end as no_valid_citation_rate, case when count(*) = 0 then 0 else round((count(*) filter (where coalesce(o.weak_citation_count, 0) > 0))::numeric / count(*), 4) end as weak_citation_rate, case when count(*) = 0 then 0 else round((count(*) filter (where o.retrieval_channel in ('keyword_only', 'vector_only', 'empty')))::numeric / count(*), 4) end as fallback_rate, cast(percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by o.total_latency_ms) filter (where o.total_latency_ms is not null) as int) as p95_total_latency_ms from ai.qa_answer_observation o join qa_message m on m.id = o.message_id and m.del_flag = '0' where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.course_id = #{courseId} and m.role = 'assistant'

select m.id as message_id, m.session_id, m.user_id, q.content as question, left(m.content, 180) as answer_preview, m.status as answer_status, m.reject_reason, m.retrieval_log_ref, o.retrieval_channel, coalesce(cast(o.warnings as text), '[]') as warnings_json, coalesce(c.citation_count, 0) as citation_count, o.top_score, o.total_latency_ms, m.create_time from qa_message m left join qa_message q on q.id = ( select max(q2.id) from qa_message q2 where q2.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and q2.session_id = m.session_id and q2.role = 'user' and q2.id < m.id and q2.del_flag = '0' ) join ai.qa_answer_observation o on o.message_id = m.id left join ( select tenant_id, message_id, count(*) as citation_count from qa_message_citation where del_flag = '0' group by tenant_id, message_id ) c on c.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and c.message_id = m.id where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.course_id = #{courseId} and m.role = 'assistant' and m.del_flag = '0'
order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc

select m.id as message_id, m.session_id, m.user_id, q.content as question, m.content as answer, m.status as answer_status, m.reject_reason, m.retrieval_log_ref, o.retrieval_channel, coalesce(cast(o.warnings as text), '[]') as warnings_json, o.retrieval_latency_ms, o.llm_latency_ms, o.first_token_ms, o.total_latency_ms, m.create_time from qa_message m left join qa_message q on q.id = ( select max(q2.id) from qa_message q2 where q2.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and q2.session_id = m.session_id and q2.role = 'user' and q2.id < m.id and q2.del_flag = '0' ) join ai.qa_answer_observation o on o.message_id = m.id where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.course_id = #{courseId} and m.id = #{messageId} and m.role = 'assistant' and m.del_flag = '0'

select l.chunk_id, kc.document_id, kc.document_version_id, d.title as document_title, kc.source_file, kc.page_start, kc.page_end, coalesce(kc.metadata_json ->> 'section_title', kc.metadata_json ->> 'title') as section_title, l.final_score as score, l.rank_no, l.used_in_prompt, exists ( select 1 from qa_message_citation c where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.message_id = #{messageId} and c.chunk_id = l.chunk_id and c.del_flag = '0' ) as cited from ai.qa_retrieval_log l left join ai.knowledge_chunk kc on kc.id = l.chunk_id left join course_document d on d.id = kc.document_id and d.del_flag = '0' where l.message_id = #{messageId} and l.rank_no <= 3 and exists ( select 1 from qa_message m where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.id = #{messageId} and m.del_flag = '0' ) order by l.rank_no, l.id
